featuresPage.title: Everything for SMS Business
featuresPage.subtitle: Complete toolkit for launching and scaling your SMS service

items.title: Provider Integration
items.desc: SMPP and HTTP protocol support. Connect any operator worldwide. Real-time connection monitoring. Automatic reconnection on failures.

items.title: Multi-tenant / Sub-accounts
items.desc: Create client accounts with individual tariffs. Control balances and limits. Complete data isolation between accounts.

items.title: Routing
items.desc: Flexible routing rules by country, operator, and cost. Priority and fallback routes. Load balancing across providers.

items.title: Cascade Delivery
items.desc: Automatic fallback on delivery failure. SMS → Viber → other channels. Configurable delivery strategies with timeouts.

items.title: Campaigns & Broadcasts
items.desc: Mass sending to contact lists. Templates with variables. Scheduled delivery. Audience segmentation.

items.title: API & Integrations
items.desc: REST API for full automation. Webhooks for delivery status. SMPP interface for high-throughput integrations.

items.title: Analytics & Reporting
items.desc: Dashboard with key metrics. Statistics by provider and client. CSV report export. Real-time monitoring.

items.title: Billing & Tarification
items.desc: Destination-based tariffs. Automatic balance deduction. Full transaction history. Per-message breakdown.

items.title: Sender Names
items.desc: Sender name management. Registration status tracking with operators. Automatic status change notifications.

items.title: HLR Lookup
items.desc: Number validation before sending. Operator and status detection. Save up to 15% on invalid numbers.
